# hwatu

> Daemon-based WebKitGTK browser for tiling WMs: real rendering, ~13ms median window spawn

A daemon-based web browser for tiling window managers. Real WebKit rendering,
terminal-emulator spawn times.

## Links

- [Repository](https://github.com/hongnoul/hwatu): source code, issues, releases
- [README](https://github.com/hongnoul/hwatu/blob/main/README.md): install and usage
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/hongnoul/hwatu/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md): measured spawn latency, verification-loop cost, memory
- [Agents guide](https://github.com/hongnoul/hwatu/blob/main/docs/agents.md): automation protocol for coding agents
